sheet.title: Prepare the base creases
sheet.instruction: Lay a thin square with a straight edge toward you. Mark both diagonals and the horizontal and vertical midlines, then reopen.
sheet.result: Eight triangular sectors meet at the center.

collapse-the-base.title: Collapse the waterbomb base
collapse-the-base.instruction: Bring the left and right midpoints inward. Let the upper edge come down to the lower edge as the diagonals close.
collapse-the-base.result: Four separate corner flaps lie in a triangle with its long edge toward you.

swing-leading-leg.title: Swing out a hind leg · Leading leg
swing-leading-leg.instruction: On the underside, take the indicated corner flap across the sloping guide and down past the long edge. Leave the upper flap in place.
swing-leading-leg.result: One lower corner projects below the belly.

swing-trailing-leg.title: Swing out a hind leg · Trailing leg
swing-trailing-leg.instruction: On the underside, take the indicated corner flap across the sloping guide and down past the long edge. Leave the upper flap in place.
swing-trailing-leg.result: One lower corner projects below the belly.

bend-leading-ankle.title: Bend the ankle · Leading leg
bend-leading-ankle.instruction: Fold the end of the indicated lower flap back on the short oblique crease, directing its tip toward the head on the left.
bend-leading-ankle.result: A short foot breaks the straight outline of the leg.

bend-trailing-ankle.title: Bend the ankle · Trailing leg
bend-trailing-ankle.instruction: Fold the end of the indicated lower flap back on the short oblique crease, directing its tip toward the head on the left.
bend-trailing-ankle.result: A short foot breaks the straight outline of the leg.

lift-the-neck.title: Lift the neck
lift-the-neck.instruction: Raise the long upper-left corner on the slanting crease. Aim its tip high above the left shoulder.
lift-the-neck.result: A long neck projects above the body.

turn-the-head.title: Turn the head
turn-the-head.instruction: Bring just the end of the neck down and to the left along the indicated slant.
turn-the-head.result: The forward-pointing wedge makes a head distinct from the neck.

square-the-muzzle.title: Blunt the muzzle
square-the-muzzle.instruction: Turn the narrow end of the snout back along the short upright crease.
square-the-muzzle.result: The muzzle has a short flat front edge.

lower-the-back.title: Lower the back
lower-the-back.instruction: Fold the central peak behind the body on the horizontal guide. Leave the head and tail free.
lower-the-back.result: The back is lower and the folded point appears beneath the belly.

shape-the-tail.title: Taper the tail
shape-the-tail.instruction: Fold the upper margin of the right-hand packet behind along the diagonal that ends at the far tip.
shape-the-tail.result: The tail narrows from a broad root to a single point.

fold-the-forelimb.title: Make the forelimb
fold-the-forelimb.instruction: Fold the loose central point back on the short slant below the chest.
fold-the-forelimb.result: A small angled forelimb rests between the neck and hind legs.

open-the-stance.title: Open the stance
open-the-stance.instruction: Ease the two lower shins in opposite directions on the marked creases. Keep the belly still.
open-the-stance.result: The feet occupy different planes and show a walking stride.

curve-the-tail.title: Turn the tail tip
curve-the-tail.instruction: Swing the outer part of the tail gently out of the body plane on the last crease.
curve-the-tail.result: The tail counterbalances the head in profile and bends away in the oblique view.
